Steve Jobs in Exile: The Untold Story of NeXT and the Remaking of an American Visionary|2026|0|0|1997|8,8,8,8,7,8,10,8,8,8|Geoffrey Cain|Examines NeXT's technical choices, costs, market difficulties and later role in Apple's software. Publisher information and a contemporary review identify documents, oral histories and interviews. The engineering decisions have wider consequences than a US personality narrative; publication is too recent for durability to be directly established. Evidence: https://penguinrandomhousehighereducation.com/book/?isbn=9780593716694 ; https://www.kirkusreviews.com/book-reviews/geoffrey-cain/steve-jobs-in-exile/

The Red Bull Story|2008|10|10|2022|6,7,6,6,7,7,3,7,8,7|Wolfgang Fürweger|Reports on brand-building, distribution, sponsorship and the founder's organization. Sports and media are central applications, so both thematic deductions apply. A verified 2025 English translation removes the language exclusion; the original German book dates to 2008. Updated founder-era coverage is assessed through his death in 2022, with low endpoint confidence. Evidence: https://books.apple.com/gb/book/the-red-bull-story/id6745795351 ; https://www.kallistipublishing.com/kallisti-publishing-inc-secures-english-rights-to-controversial-book-about-the-founder-of-red-bull/ ; https://books.google.com/books/about/Die_Red_Bull_Story.html?hl=en&id=lsF8KAAACAAJ&output=html_text
